mcqs.q: Which 13th-century temple in Odisha is designed as a colossal 24-wheeled chariot pulled by seven horses, known as the 'Black Pagoda'?
mcqs.exp: Sun Temple at Konark was built around 1250 AD by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga Dynasty.

mcqs.q: Chilika Lake in Odisha, a designated Ramsar wetland site, is famous for which unique marine mammal species?
mcqs.exp: Chilika Lake is the primary habitat for the endangered Irrawaddy dolphin in India.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Odisha.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Bhubaneswar. Odisha covers a geographic area of 155,707 sq km across 30 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Mahanadi (Hirakud Dam), Brahmani, Baitarani, Subarnarekha, Rushikulya.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Originally Kalinga, whose battlefield converted Emperor Ashoka to Buddhism (261 BCE). Home to Sun Temple Konark, Jagannath Temple Puri, Chilika Lake, and Olive Ridley sea turtle nesting.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Odisha.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Odisha was formally instituted on 1 April 1936. Official language(s): Odia (Classical Language).

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Odissi (Classical Dance), Chhau (Mayurbhanj), Gotipua, Sambalpuri.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Rath Yatra (Puri Chariot Festival), Nuakhai, Raja Parba, Bali Jatra.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Odisha.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Raghubar Das.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Odisha is Mohan Charan Majhi.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Orissa High Court (Cuttack).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Sambar deer | State Bird: Indian roller | State Flower: Ashoka | State Tree: Sacred fig (Peepal).

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Odisha.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Iron Ore (Mayurbhanj, Keonjhar), Bauxite (Panchpatmali), Chromite (Sukinda), Coal (Talcher).

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Odisha plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Odisha.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Konark Sun Temple (Black Pagoda, UNESCO), Jagannath Temple Puri, Lingaraj Temple, Dhauli Shanti Stupa.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Similipal National Park (Biosphere Reserve), Bhitarkanika National Park.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Odisha.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Subhadra Yojana, Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana, KALIA Scheme.
